replying_to: Replying to Statistical Characterization of Deep Neural Networks and their Sensitivity

content.title: Additional work is required
content.comment:
We identified shortcomings in the current version of our paper, and we believe additional work is required to reach higher standards. Therefore we would like to withdraw our submission.

We are grateful to the organizers for the opportunity, and to the reviewers for their valuable time.  We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience. Thank you for your understanding.

content.title: Submission Withdrawn by the Authors
content.withdrawal confirmation: I have read and agree with the withdrawal statement on behalf of myself and my co-authors.
